metadata.chunk_title: Eligibility Criteria for PG Courses

facts.value: Students who wish to pursue further studies in Biomedical Sciences after completion of their Bachelor's degree can do so through a Master of Science (M.Sc) in the subject. Admissions into M.Sc. Biomedical Science courses are conducted either based on merit or with the help of entrance exams.

metadata.chunk_title: Entrance Exams for PG Courses

facts.value: While there are no common entrance exams, most colleges offer admission based on their performance in graduation. The remaining few institutes prefer to conduct their entrance examinations as part of the screening process during admissions.
